EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Ref. No.: NCP/MG/L02/General/07-04. Land Ministry’s Ref. No.: 4/3/9/2010/IR/201 dated

12.06.2015. I hereby give Notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act that the Government intends to acquire the under mentioned lands which are required for the purpose of construction of the Medirigiriya Kantale Road under the Medirigiriya, Moragahakanda, Kaluganga Development Project. Description of the land to be acquired:

The allotments of land described below as shown in the Plan in the Sheet No. 05 in the Zone No. 01 in the C.P. No. 120098 of the Surveyor General Located in the Village of Kauduluwewa Stage II, Yaya 06 (part) in the No. 96, Diggalpura Grama Niladhari’s Division in the Minor Division of Sinhala Pattuwa in the Medirigiriya Division Secretary’s Division in the District of Polonnaruwa in the North Central Province.

Divisional Secretary, Medirigiriya. Medirigiriya Divisonal Secretariat, 01st June, 2017. 06-770
